items.title: Confirm whether to commission the survey (Gutachten)
items.quote: Bitte geben Sie uns innerhalb von 15 Werktagen nach dem Briefdatum Bescheid, ob wir das Gutachten erstellen sollen; als Werktage zählen Montag bis Samstag, nicht aber Sonn- und Feiertage.
items.computation: Letter date (Briefdatum) is 20.11.2026 (Friday). The period runs 'nach dem Briefdatum', so under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (20.11.) is not counted; counting starts 21.11.2026. The letter defines Werktage itself as Monday to Saturday excluding Sundays and public holidays, matching the statutory definition. Counting 15 such working days from 21.11.2026: Sundays 22.11, 29.11 and 06.12 are skipped (no public holidays fall in this window in NW or HE), landing on Tuesday 08.12.2026. That day is itself a working day, so no further shift under § 193 BGB is needed. Verified with the add_working_days and compute_deadline tools (both return 2026-12-08).

warnings: The firm's quote amount itself is said to be in an enclosed offer ("das Angebot liegt bei") that was not included with the text provided, so the price could not be verified.
The note that the customer office is closed on 10.12.2026 for a staff meeting is purely informational and falls after the 08.12.2026 reply deadline, so it does not affect the deadline.
